en.headline: Immigration relaxes Seamless e-Channel rules at HZMB port
en.dek: Hong Kong permanent residents aged 11 or above who have used the bridge port six times in 90 days can now enrol, with on-the-spot registration added at designated channels.
body: The Immigration Department said on Thursday that eligibility for the Pilot Seamless e-Channel service at the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Hong Kong Port has been relaxed with immediate effect.

Hong Kong permanent residents aged 11 or above who hold a valid smart identity card and have arrived in or left Hong Kong through the port’s Passenger Clearance Building six times or more in the past 90 days may now enrol. Residents aged 18 or above can complete registration at designated e-Channels at the port as well as through the Contactless e-Channel mobile application.

The department said the system will automatically identify eligible passengers at those channels and display an on-screen prompt, so travellers can opt in while clearing immigration. Once enrolled, they can use the open-gate service on later departures without presenting an identity card or QR code. The pilot uses artificial intelligence and facial recognition.

About 14,000 eligible permanent residents have enrolled since the pilot began on 25 June, with more than 100,000 passenger trips recorded. Immigration said it will keep reviewing operations and consider extending the service to other control points and other categories of travellers.

zh.headline: 入境處放寬港珠澳大橋無感e-道登記資格
zh.dek: 年滿11歲的香港永久性居民，只要過去90日經大橋口岸出入境六次或以上，即日起可登記；18歲或以上亦可在指定e-道即場辦理。
body: 入境事務處周四公布，即日起放寬港珠澳大橋香港口岸「無感e-道」試點服務的登記資格。
凡年滿11歲、持有效智能身份證，並於過去90日內經大橋口岸旅檢大樓入境或出境達六次或以上的香港永久性居民，均符合資格。年滿18歲的合資格居民除可透過「非觸式e-道」流動應用程式登記外，亦可在口岸指定e-道即場完成手續。
入境處表示，合資格旅客使用指定e-道過關時，系統會自動識別並在螢幕提示，旅客可選擇同步完成過關及登記。登記後，其後出境時毋須出示身份證或二維碼，即可使用開閘式通道。試點採用人工智能及面容識別。
服務自6月25日推出以來，約1.4萬名合資格永久性居民已登記，使用人次超過10萬。入境處會繼續檢視運作數據，研究把服務擴展至其他管制站，以及放寬至其他類別旅客。
